data.gender_notes: Sharula is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Sharula is derived from the Sanskrit word Shri, which means 'goddess of wealth, prosperity and fortune'. The name Sharula is believed to bring wealth, abundance and success in all areas of life. The name Sharula carries the meaning “Goddess of Prosperity” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit. Parents who choose Sharula usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of prosperity and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Sharula is a powerful name with deep spiritual significance. It is believed to invoke the blessings of the goddess Lakshmi, who is the goddess of wealth, prosperity and abundance. The name Sharula is also believed to symbolize strength, courage and protection.
data.etymology: Sharula belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Goddess of Prosperity.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sharula total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
